scoring_justification: Headline quantities (spin densities and bond energies) are produced by a heavy DFT pipeline; the verifier cannot re-run DFT to recompute them from raw electronic structure intermediates, so it compares the agent's reported values to the paper gold within tolerances and validates the D2 > D1 structural trend.

outputs.description: Mulliken spin density on the Al_t* atom for each Al13X- radical anion. The checker compares the reported values to a hidden gold reference with an appropriate tolerance.

Successive ligand addition energies D1 and D2 for each ligand X, with ZPE corrections. The checker compares reported values to a hidden gold reference and also verifies the condition D2 > D1 for every ligand.

output_contract.notes: All DFT calculations must be performed with an open-source quantum chemistry package supporting the B3LYP functional and the 6-31G* / 6-311+G* basis sets. The initial icosahedral geometry is constructed from standard coordinates. The load-bearing bond_energies step is unreachable without completing the process steps.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for spin densities and bond energies extracted from the paper tables.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1a (spin densities) and Table 2 (D1, D2) with D1 for C6H5 taken from supplementary text or calculations; values confirmed against the reference solver solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual extraction from paper markdown and cross-checked against solve.sh oracle output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper (Tables 1a and 2) and used by the reference solver.
